ranked.headline: Computational frameworks link variants and chromatin marks to gene regulation and cancer
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and journal papers apply statistical models to link somatic variants, TF binding and histone marks with expression and phenotypes.

ranked.headline: Read-level inference advances sequencing error estimation and variant calling
ranked.summary: Reference-free and read-level methods now estimate sequencing error and call variants directly from raw signals and sketches.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose metric and baseline failures in biological response prediction models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show that common metrics and simple baselines can mislead evaluation of biological response models, prompting stricter validation.

ranked.headline: Learned representations drive peptide binding prediction and generative design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply language-model embeddings, equivariant geometry and DEL-trained transformers to protein and peptide design tasks.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models infer genomic function and phenotype from sequence data
ranked.summary: Scaling sequence-based inference to bacterial genomes, gut microbiomes and large protein sets requires compact, biologically informed representations.

ranked.headline: Fused heterogeneous inputs drive drug and protein interaction prediction models
ranked.summary: February 2026 work pairs multimodal drug, protein and cell-line features with graph and transformer architectures for interaction and synergy prediction.

ranked.headline: Trap spaces and information frameworks formalize cell-state dynamics and regulatory demand
ranked.summary: Explicit dynamical and information-theoretic models are now linking biomarkers, transcriptomic trajectories, and regulatory demand to cell states.

ranked.headline: Sequence language models extended to DNA, RNA, codon, and oligonucleotide prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend biological sequence models with latent predictive objectives, long-context compression, and structure-aware feedback.

ranked.headline: Computational tools prioritize disease genes and variants across genomic data types
ranked.summary: Variant calibration, ancestry-aware predictor benchmarking and xQTL-GWAS integration extend gene prioritization toward clinical and drug target use.

ranked.headline: Raw-read pipelines infer resistance determinants directly from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Nanopore and metagenomic short-read data now support end-to-end resistance calling in open-source, containerized or web-accessible tools.

ranked.headline: Computational methods nominate candidate targets across aging and age-related disease
ranked.summary: Existing public datasets and causal-genetic methods now enable candidate target nomination without new experimental screens.

ranked.headline: Transcriptome tools refine isoform, splicing and differential expression inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers extend long-read isoform workflows, splicing models and artifact scoring for transcriptome analysis.

ranked.headline: Pretrained and generative models extend to protein, antibody, and MD trajectory tasks
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein language models and diffusion or flow-matching generators are now applied across design, prediction, and dynamics tasks.

ranked.headline: Binding free energy and generative design methods aim at synthesizable ligands
ranked.summary: Recent papers pair docking, free energy and generative models with synthesizability and binding-site focus to make ligand design more tractable.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links synteny and repeats to lineage-specific gene evolution
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply chromosome-scale assemblies and synteny-aware analyses to test gene-level evolution in myxozoans and ants.

ranked.headline: LLM agents build evidence-linked biomedical claims and perturbation predictions
ranked.summary: Preprints pair LLM agents and knowledge graphs with perturbation prediction and pathway curation, while auditing single-cell foundation model attention.

ranked.headline: Cancer genome profiling links alterations to evolutionary and mutational processes
ranked.summary: Single-cell, tumor-level, and pan-cancer sequencing resources now allow alteration-level resolution of cancer genome evolution, loss, and repair deficiency.

ranked.headline: Deep learning imposes spatial domain and cell-type structure on spatial omics data
ranked.summary: Spatial omics platforms yield sparse, heterogeneous measurements that neural models now aim to structure at cell, domain, and tissue scales.

ranked.headline: Energy budgets are formalised as explicit constraints on neural coding and synapses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalise metabolic or energy costs as explicit constraints on neural firing rates and synaptic variance.

ranked.headline: Supervised models predict drug, peptide and cancer endpoints from molecular data
ranked.summary: Routine NMR metabolomics, public screening data and protein language model embeddings now feed tabular, graph and liquid neural network predictors.

ranked.headline: Metagenomic and genomic analyses link microbial gene variation to host outcomes
ranked.summary: Large-scale bifidobacterial genome atlases, universal gene bimodality, and metabolic models now connect microbial genomes to host and probiotic outcomes.

ranked.headline: New software tools for alignment, motif, regulatory, and phenotype-network analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication add reusable software for alignment, regulatory-motif, phenotype-network, and epigenomic analysis.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and de novo design target TDP-43 aggregation and GPCR modulation
ranked.summary: Recent items apply ML screening and deep-learning protein design to TDP-43 aggregation and GPCR modulators, adding hERG-aware safety modeling.

ranked.headline: Time-varying directed coupling and criticality refine functional brain connectivity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication extend connectivity biomarkers to time-varying directed coupling, criticality scaling, and representational drift.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer microbial diversity from genomic and surveillance data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply ML, richness estimation, and wastewater deconvolution to inferring microbial and viral diversity from indirect data.

ranked.headline: Pseudotime expression forecasting by single-cell models versus simple linear baselines
ranked.summary: Foundation models for single-cell data are now being tested for trajectory forecasting against linear baselines and cross-cell-type consistency constraints.

ranked.headline: Resource limits, growth trade-offs and immunity shape microbial population outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent models link growth, kill rates, resource fluctuations and horizontal transfer to selection outcomes in antimicrobial, plasmid and cholera settings.

ranked.headline: Tools structure fermentation, metagenomic and genomic data into machine-actionable form
ranked.summary: Recent items target interoperability, local integration and reproducibility for bioprocess, metagenomic and bacterial genomic data.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer atomic coordinates and volumes from cryo-EM and cryo-ET density
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 preprints apply diffusion and autoencoder models to map experimental cryo-EM and cryo-ET density onto structures.

ranked.headline: Acquisition-aware mass spectrometry software modeling physics for identification
ranked.summary: Untargeted proteomics and metabolomics tools now encode acquisition physics and scale to hundreds of millions of spectra.

ranked.headline: Enhanced-sampling and umbrella MD resolve ion channel and membrane peptide energetics
ranked.summary: Long-timescale and enhanced-sampling simulations now resolve gating, conduction, and translocation energetics in channels and membrane peptides.

ranked.headline: Exact alignment algorithms cut runtime and storage for graph and pangenome data
ranked.summary: Pangenome-scale alignment workloads, such as 390M alignments in one study, demand faster and more compact exact methods.

ranked.headline: Membrane context shifts lipid pKa and PDIM distribution in simulated bilayers
ranked.summary: Constant-pH and MARTINI 3 simulations now quantify how membrane environments shift lipid protonation and outer-membrane lipid organization.

ranked.headline: Symmetry constraints shape generative and predictive models of molecular structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply group symmetry and physically defined quantities such as the committor to molecular generative and predictive models.

ranked.headline: Computational pipelines resolve repeat element age, recombination and architecture
ranked.summary: Assembly-level data now recover insertion ages, recombination partners, regulatory annotation and repeat architecture.

ranked.headline: Draft and community-curated genome annotations across beetles, nematodes and fruit flies
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study extend genome annotation quality and orthology coverage across insect and nematode lineages.

ranked.headline: Noncoding GWAS variants mapped to target genes, splicing, and 3D chromatin contacts
ranked.summary: Multi-layer readouts now link noncoding Alzheimer's and bone density GWAS variants to regulatory targets, isoforms, and cis interactions.

ranked.headline: Pseudoknot-aware RNA folding and 3D motif libraries extend small RNA modeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a PIWI cleavage model add pseudoknot-capable folding, graph-based 3D motif search and piRNA target prediction tools.

ranked.headline: Sequence-derived structure and function inference and its documented failure limits
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and co-folding tests show sequence-based inference breaks on epistatic mutations and ligand input choices.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and EM optimization applied to cryoprotectant, genetic, and protein inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication apply Bayesian optimization, Adam-based updates, and EM to design and inference problems beyond molecular structure modeling.
